segments.name: Alarm.com
segments.description: Runs cloud platforms and sells hardware for connected homes and businesses through service providers.
segments.evidence: Alarm.com segment represents our cloud-based and Software platforms for intelligently connected properties and related solutions that contributed 91%, 92% and 93% of our revenue, net of intersegment eliminations, for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Develops automation and energy management products for adjacent markets.
segments.evidence: Our Other segment is focused on researching, developing and offering residential and commercial automation solutions and energy management products and services in adjacent markets.

revenueModel.text: Service provider partners pay it for platforms and hardware and resell them to property owners.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our platform and hardware solutions to service provider partners that resell our solutions and hardware to residential and commercial property owners, who are the service provider partners' customers.
